decisions: Local Python/PySide6/Pillow/Shapely editor; complete root DALE portable package after every update, supplied ICO unchanged.
Scene image (JPG/JPEG) plus Foundry 13/14 scene JSON; same-stem pairing. Separate JSON command loads a scene JSON directly or selects from all declared scene JSON documents in a DALE project.
No legacy support: schema 2 only; reject older/unknown archives, no migrations or old UI aliases.

Every edge has stable ID, parent lineage and exact source JSON SHA256/array pointer/optional Foundry ID. Splits, merges, contacts and transforms preserve ancestry; deleted ancestors and contact markers persist in history/redo.

File/Edit/About menus own general commands. Top panels: Sections (text Contours/Regions/Raster), Scene (text Levels), Main (36px square icon-only Hand/Clear selection/Fit/Show contours/Settings). One left toolbar in an unframed stack, no nested wrapper. Separate right Project/Scene/Settings pages; every page owns the same240px bottom Information. Levels cancels previews, hides left editing tools and uses Pan; empty Scene/Levels group reserves future controls without semantic generation.

Local and whole-map directional auto-close have independent screen tolerances, white preview, Cancel/Yes before mutation, one undo step; no standalone connectors. Materialize T/shared contacts and tiny gaps.
Fixed-size point handles, Alt vector-constrained drag, vertex-first snapping. Geometry erasers preview white affected points/lines.
Select minimum cell under cursor; toggle/add/remove multiple selection, translucent cyan. Explicit selection exports individual cells; All regions exports connected objects.

Move regions changes geometry only. Optional remembered related-line choice with right-click configuration. Drag translates, Ctrl-wheel scales; a separate Rotate regions button uses plain wheel at 0.1 degree per notch around stable shared pivot; raster and mask snapshots stay fixed.

The only artwork margin is the left Regions Artwork offset, signed -4096..4096 source pixels. Current offset applies to export outside boundaries; original raster and preview mask snapshots stay fixed. Bicubic 2x alpha smoothing preserves native RGB. Exact crop includes every nonzero byte (even 1/255), clamped to JPG. No mandatory 3px guard or global transparent-padding parameter.
Portable merged preferences retain language, Foundry version, related-line choice, independent input/output folders shared across file types. Never persist extraction directories.
Current .dale JSON catalog preserves original and additional updated documents. Generation of updated Foundry JSON remains future work.
Chat Russian, technical text English, bilingual UI/tooltips with actual shortcuts; no private example uploads.
Build revision increments once per invocation; major/minor only owner instruction. PNG/manifest do not create Foundry levels.

Walls off hides all inactive lines, offsets and handles in every tool. Retain selected cells in region tools and only highlighted/current gesture geometry elsewhere; white hover rendering must not redraw base centerlines.

Transform isolation requirement: freeze selected/optional related geometry before move/scale/rotation; do not snap, repair or extend stationary lines toward it. Owner-reported defect is pending NEXT-009, not fixed in this research task.

Foundry semantic export is research only: distinct v13/v14 serializers, explicit floors/Regions/doors/teleport semantics, ordered endpoints/shapes and ID/UUID remapping. Preserve original/updated catalog separation; no legacy .dale support.

Accept Foundry-permitted setting combinations. Preserve original bytes/values; finite inverted wall-height bounds may be normalized in working/generated records with an auditable difference; null remains unbounded.

All eight numeric tool values save in projects. Store settings globally defaults off; enabling copies active values to portable config, which loads first and overrides project numbers while enabled. Unchecking restores separate project values. Global-mode saving preserves the project numbers and artwork offset, not global overrides.

Clear selection follows Hand in the second top row; Ctrl+Shift+A clears selected cells/contour highlights and cancels previews without editing geometry/raster or changing mode. English/Russian action names identify regions, contours, lines/points or raster; internal keys remain stable.

Right Project contains Regions then File information. Settings is a separate page opened by Main Settings, with target/language/global scope. Scene Levels is a separate placeholder page. All three Information copies share one current-mode/actual-enabled-shortcut source and top-aligned scrollable text; settings toggles back to the active scene/project page.

Circular contours are existing editable polygon edges: press center, drag radius, release one undo step without confirmation. Preview changes vertices live in both directions. Diameter in imported grid cells <=0.5:4 vertices, <=1:6, <=2:8; then add two per started 2.5 cells, capped at4096. Missing/invalid grid uses100 source pixels per cell; source scale conversion and zoom-independent density. Ctrl+wheel adjusts active radius, Escape/Clear selection cancels. Exact contacts retain ancestry; source JSON stays unchanged.

Foundry Regions offer native circle shapes, but DALE circular contours remain working polygon edges suitable for future wall/Region polygon export. Do not infer native circles after point edits or claim semantic scene generation.

Auto-close and whole-map close show Cancel/Yes only when changes exist; no-op/empty-cursor information has only Close. File/Edit/About menu commands retain shortcuts; About displays the running title/version and localized purpose.

Application and general workflow terminology is Scene, Scene image, Scene JSON and Contours in both languages. JSON contains a whole Scene, not only geometry. DALE project means .dale archive. Actual native fields/API/module names such as walls remain literal in technical format descriptions. No wire-field rename, alias or archive migration is introduced for UI terminology. Source warnings retranslate on language changes; obsolete UI translation entries are removed.

Large exact PNG sidebar bounds run in one cancellable worker with immutable Session/polygon snapshots. Keep only the latest pending request, ignore stale results and cache at most16 outcomes. Inline scans are limited to262144 candidate pixels. Show localized pending state; defer ready-result repaint during active gestures. Export uses identical exact nonzero alpha bounds. Contour-only edits reuse unchanged raster preview/Pixmap. Cancel and join worker on application shutdown.

The added 13.351 scene probe changes only tiles and statistics, adding one locked Tile with screenshot-confirmed placement/texture/occlusion/restrictions. Future extracted floor PNGs will be referenced by Tile assets using resolved scene coordinates, explicit elevation/sort and version-specific Level/occlusion semantics. Tile generation remains future work; preserve originals and separate updated JSON catalog snapshots.

Every Git push needs a fresh explicit owner request. Default origin/development; origin/release only when explicitly named and separately confirmed for a concrete commit/plan. Use the versioned dale-push skill/helper and local pre-push guard. No automatic push after edits/builds/commits/CI, no automatic failed-attempt retry or hook bypass; configure local Git only. Skill setup is not a push request.

File > Recent projects is always present. Merge up to10 unique absolute successful .dale open/save paths into portable preferences, newest first. Entry opening respects save/discard/cancel; missing paths stay disabled with help. Clear list preserves files. Never store temporary extraction paths.
